24-hour In-Room Dining (including Breakfast on the Fly options for early morning departures)

pois.name: Entry to Fairmont Vancouver Airport Hotel
pois.description:
Fairmont Vancouver Airport is the only soundproofed, luxury hotel and spa conveniently located within Vancouver's International Airport (YVR). Situated directly above the US departures terminal, the hotel is only a two-minute stroll from the luggage carousels. Recently voted the #1 Airport Hotel in North America for the fourth year in a row at the 2017 Skytrax World Airport Awards, this AAA / CAA 4-diamond Vancouver luxury airport hotel boasts breathtaking mountain, ocean and runway views, award-winning dining options in Jetside Bar and restaurant Globe@YVR, as well as 8,880 square feet of meeting space, an indoor pool, health club and full service spa. Fairmont Vancouver Airport is designed for the discerning traveler combining convenience and first-class amenities with exceptional service and a sophisticated approach to modern travel. 

Unique guest services include:

24-hour In-Room Dining (including Breakfast on the Fly options for early morning departures)
Day Use Rooms (with designated 'Quiet Zones' for a restful layover experience)
Fit on the Fly (day passes to the full service Health Club, including access to head-to-toe workout gear)
Airport Chauffeur (offering pre-security transfer service within YVR)
Fish Valet (with 575 cubic feet freezer for guests to store their latest catch before flying home)
keywords: Entry to Fairmont Vancouver Airport Hotel

pois.name: Plaza Premium Lounge - Entrance
pois.description:
Passengers have access to first-class lounge facilities at YVR's Plaza Premium lounges, regardless of airline or ticket class.

The lounge offers a cozy and inviting ambiance. Delight in an array of both warm and cold culinary offerings with an assortment of specialty coffees, teas, and juices. For those seeking to unwind with a refreshing drink, we are pleased to serve alcoholic beverages after 9:30 am in the lounge.

Throughout the lounges and at the fully equipped computer workstations, guests can stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or charge devices in one of many power sockets. We want our guests to have a sense of belonging when they arrive, an experience that says "You are a member of Plaza Premium Lounge."

pois.description: At Hangar 49, comfort meets creativity. Whether you're craving a hearty classic or something lighter and more adventurous, Hangar 49 Tap + Tavern has curated a variety of dishes to satisfy every palate and every journey.

pois.name: Moose Knuckles
pois.description: For over a century, Moose Knuckles has been outfitting fearless explorers with outerwear that defies the cold and redefines luxury. Built for the tundra yet designed for the city, every piece is engineered with impeccable tailoring, ethically sourced materials, and premium hardware to keep you warm at your core. With a relentless commitment to sustainability, Moose Knuckles is continuously evolving, ensuring that 50% of all fabrics come from responsible sources by 2025. pois.description: Discover diverse Asian food from celebrated Canadian chef and Top Chef Canada All-Stars champion Nicole Gomes. Enjoy relaxed sit-down dining in the beautiful restaurant space or visit the grab and go market for a selection of ready-made dishes perfect for a meal at your gate or on board your flight.
